summary: Bound out-of-order resource preparation during replication admission

replay.detail: Out-of-order resource claims mark preparation stale and queue a paged deferred fold instead of rebuilding the full subject history during admission. Complete observations publish atomically; canonical claim ordering and validation are unchanged.

schema.detail: Preparation cache version 2 adopts complete version-1 rows without rebuilding their history and persists rebuild progress and admission wakes. No client protocol or generated type changes.

rules.detail: After four folded-prefix resets, envelopes touching the affected subject wait retryably for a prioritized paced rebuild. They remain atomic and are not quarantined; other eligible envelopes and foreground writers continue.

compatibility.detail: Resource preparation uses bounded writer work units for large or out-of-order claim histories. Query-only readers use the canonical snapshot fold while preparation is stale; writer-context reads report resource-preparation-not-caught-up instead of performing an unbounded fold. Receive metrics distinguish preparation from shared writer work.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond the normal binary restart.

manual.detail: No additional setup or configuration changes.

recovery.detail: Persisted stale marks resume at startup without a new replication receive. An older binary detects the preparation cache version change and rebuilds before serving readers; canonical claims retain their current format.
